description: This file implements the HibernateSchedulerDAO class, which is a data access object (DAO) for task scheduling in the OpenMRS system. It provides CRUD operations for TaskDefinition objects using Hibernate ORM, including methods to create, retrieve (by ID, name, UUID), update, delete, and list tasks. The class interacts with Hibernate session factory and constructs criteria queries for database operations.
